जीविक

ई-मेल-dmmu.balodabazar@gmail.com
बलौदाबाजार दिनांक 20/04/2026
विकास आयुक्त कार्यालय, SRLM प्रकोष्ठ विकास भवन, नवा रायपुर, अटल
नगर के पत्र क्र. ESTB/1107/2025-Section CGSRLM नवा रायपुर दिनांक 23.02.2026 नवा रायपुर,
में दिये गये निर्देशानुसार छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन "बिहान" अंतर्गत जिला पंचायत
सारंगढ़-बिलाईगढ़ (छ.ग.) में विकासखंड परियोजना प्रबंधक (01 पद), क्षेत्रीय समन्वयक (01 पद)
एवं लेखापाल (01 पद) के संविदा रिक्त पदों पर भर्ती हेतु वांछित अर्हताधारी एवं इच्छुक अभ्यर्थियों
से आवेदन पत्र दिनांक 04/05/2026 सायं 5.00 बजे तक मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी,
जिला पंचायत बलौदाबाजार, जिला बलौदाबाजार-भाटापारा पिन कोड 493332 के नाम से
स्पीड पोस्ट / रजिस्टर्ड पोस्ट के माध्यम से आमंत्रित किया जाता है।
उक्त संविदा रिक्त पद पर चयन हेतु विस्तृत विज्ञापन, पदों की संख्या, निर्धारित
शैक्षणिक योग्यता एवं अन्य जानकारी तथा आवेदन का प्रारूप जिला बलौदाबाजार भाटापारा के
वेबसाईट https://balodabazar.gov.in एवं कार्यालय, जिला पंचायत बलौदाबाजार भाटापारा के सूचना
पटल पर देखी जा सकती है।

1. मिशन संचालक, SRLM विकास आयुक्त कार्यालय, विकास भवन, अटल नगर नवा रायपुर (छ.
ग.) को सादर सूचनार्थ ।
कलेक्टर, जिला बलौदाबाजार भाटापारा एवं जिला सारंगढ़-बिलाईगढ़ को सादर सूचनार्थ ।
मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जिला पंचायत सारंगढ़- बिलाईगढ़ को सूचनार्थ ।
4. जिला सूचना एवं विज्ञान अधिकारी,  जिला बलौदाबाजार को वेबसाईट में अपलोड करने हेतु ।
5. सहायक संचालक, जन संपर्क, जिला बलौदाबाजार को दैनिक समाचार पत्रों में विज्ञापन
प्रकाशनार्थ प्रेषित ।
6.
मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जनपद पंचायत समस्त, जिला बलौदाबाजार भाटापारा एवं मुख्य
कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जनपद पंचायत बिलाईगढ़ को जनपद कार्यालय एवं समस्त ग्राम पंचायत
के सूचना पटल में चस्पा कराने एवं प्रमाण-पत्र प्रेषित करने हेतु पालनार्थ ।

Date: 19.03.2026 
 
NOTICE 
 
 
NESTS notified for the recruitment of teaching and non-teaching staff for EMRSs through ESSE 
2025. Schedule of the Tier-II examination of ESSE 2025 was notified on 25.02.2026. 
Candidates can download their admit cards of the Tier-II examination scheduled from 22nd to 25th 
March 2026 from the link mentioned below: 
 
https://examinationservices.nic.in/AdmitCardservice/Admitcard/Login?enc=zXMjq8b4zJzMENzA
wi+ezNVxJ6L8Y01S8g8WZywidXY= 
 
Admit cards will be available to download only 3 days before the date of examination.  
The candidates should Login on this link by using their registration no. (which has starting digits 
2599) and password created by them while submitting online application on the portal.  
The application number should not be used by candidates while login.

Date: 03.03.2026 
 
NOTICE 
 
NESTS notified for the recruitment of teaching and non-teaching staff for EMRSs 
through ESSE 2025. The result of the Tier-I examination was declared vide notice dated 
31.01.2026. 
The examination city allotted to candidates who have been shortlisted for Tier-II 
examination may be checked by them on the link given below: 
https://examinationservices.nic.in/AdmitCard/AuthForCity/Login?enc=DJ8reokIYh
e/x0Hlb6GKa+Ca/EDLWeJC1iBcsgW0q6s= 
The candidates should Login on this link by using their registration no. (which has 
starting digits 2599) and their password created by them while submitting online 
application on the portal.  
The application number should not be used by candidates while login. 
It is also intimated that in respect of TGT Regional language, the question paper of Tier-
II examination will be in the respective regional language. For others, Tier - II will be 
conducted only in Hindi and English medium. It has no link with language competency 
of medium opted by candidates in Tier -I.  
The admit card with details of examination centre and schedule of examination will be 
available 02 days before examination.

Date: 19.02.2026 
 
NOTICE 
 
 
NESTS notified for recruitment of teaching and non-teaching staff through ESSE-
2025. Tier-I result has been published. Many representations are being received 
requesting for re-checking of result to confirm their declared score of the 
individuals concerned. It is noticed on verifying the representations that either the 
candidates are not calculating their marks (right/wrong answers) properly or 
calculating their result with wrong answer key. Therefore, considering the similar 
requests, it is notified that the candidates appeared in Tier-I examination of ESSE-
2025 may apply for calculation sheet along with a copy of their attempted OMR 
sheet with the prescribed fee @Rs. 500/- per post on or before 07.03.2026. 
Candidates who had sought clarifications including information under RTI or 
otherwise are also required to apply afresh for the calculation sheet along with the 
required fee. No other mode of requesting clarification will be entertained.  
 
The prescribed fee is to be remitted to CBSE through Bank Draft in favour of 
Secretary, CBSE payable at Delhi/New Delhi issued by any of the scheduled 
banks.  The candidates should mention their Roll No., Post applied for, Name & 
Address correctly in their application and enclose a copy of the ESSE-2025 admit 
card (Tier I). The Roll Number & Name should also be mentioned on the back side 
of the Bank Draft. The application should be sent by speed post or by hand only to 
Director, CTET Unit, Central Board of Secondary Education, P.S. 1-2, I. P. 
Extension, Patparganj, Delhi – 110092 within the stipulated period, failing which 
no further correspondence will be entertained. 
 
The calculation sheet shall be sent only on the registered e-mail id of the applicant, 
who had appeared for the Tier-I exam. The calculation sheet shall not be provided 
to any institution or school for display, commercial purpose or to print media. 
Application submitted on behalf of the candidate and the incomplete application 
will be summarily rejected without any further reference. 
 
The decision of the Competent Authority of CBSE shall be final and binding on the 
candidates. However, no request will be entertained under any circumstances 
which will be received after 07.03.2026 in the office of CBSE.

Date: 07.02.2026 
 
NOTICE

CHAPTER 1: INTRODUCTION 
• National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS), an autonomous organization established 
under Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, invites online application from eligible and 
interested Indian Citizens for recruitment on Direct basis to the posts of Principal, Post Graduate 
Teachers, Trained Graduate Teachers, Hostel Warden (Male and Female), Female Staff Nurse, 
Accountant, Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) and Lab Attendant. 
• In addition to normal teaching duties, the teachers are required to perform responsibilities attached 
with residential system of schooling like House Mastership, remedial and supervisory studies, 
organization of co-curricular activities, escorting of students on official purposes and looking after 
students’ welfare in general. During the period of probation of the incumbent, performance in all 
these areas will also be assessed, in addition to the teaching ability to determine suitability for the 
job.  
•  In respect of non-teaching staff, they are required to perform residential duties.  
• All the staff in EMRSs are eligible for special pay @ 10% of the basic pay. 
• In view of the admission policy that girls and boys are admitted in the ratio of 1:1 in EMRS, efforts 
will be made to post male and female teachers as per the approved policy of NESTS i.e., minimum 
of 20% and maximum of 60% female staff in each EMRS and as per the administrative need of 
EMRSs subject to the condition that they fulfill the normal eligibility conditions. However, there 
is no separate reservation for Female Teachers to this effect.  
• The candidates may be posted anywhere in India on initial posting on selection and request for 
change of station/region will not be entertained under any circumstances whatsoever. 
 
Objectives of EMRS 
 
Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs) are established with the objective of providing 
quality education from Class VI to XII students belonging to ST category. These schools are set 
up at block level as residential schools and have separate hostels for boys and girls, 
accommodation for staff, mess facility, playground and all other amenities. For details of locations 
and amenities, please see website of NESTS (https://nests.tribal.gov.in). EMRSs, being fully 
residential institutions, teaching and non-teaching staff are required to stay on campus for which 
rent free accommodation as available will be provided.

Important instruction:  
A. Functional Requirements for Posts - Compliance by PwBD Candidates  
In accordance with the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, it is 
hereby notified that candidates falling under the Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) category must ensure 
compliance with the functional requirements prescribed for the post(s) for which they intend to apply.  
1. Verification of Functional Requirements: It shall be the responsibility of the PwBD candidates to ensure that they 
meet the functional requirements for the specific post(s) prior to applying. 
2. Certification Requirement: Candidates who are shortlisted for Interview/ document verification shall be required to 
mandatorily produce a certificate issued by Civil Surgeon or CMO of a government hospital. This certificate must 
substantiate that the candidate fulfills the functional requirements stipulated for the post(s) applied for.  
3. Consequence of Non-compliance: Failure to adhere to the aforementioned requirements may render the candidate 
ineligible for the post(s) concerned, without prejudice to any other condition of eligibility or selection criteria.  
 
B. Details regarding essential and desirable qualifications for various categories of posts, Pay Scales with Level, Age 
limit, Relaxation of age, Mode of Selection and other related details are given. In addition to the pay scale, selected 
candidates will be entitled to draw admissible allowances besides 10% special allowance for performing residential 
duties.  
Other instructions: - 
 
a. 
Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. 
b. 
The vacancies for the posts included in this recruitment notification are tentative and may increase or decrease. 
No claim will be entertained, if there is any variation in the number of posts/ delay in issuing the Appointment 
cum Posting Order. 
c. 
NESTS reserves the right to fill or not to fill or partially fill any of the above vacancies without assigning any 
reasons whatsoever. NESTS also reserves the right to cancel/ restrict / modify/ alter the recruitment process, if 
required, without giving any further notice or assigning any reasons thereof. 
d. 
The recruitment shall be in accordance with the latest recruitment rules notified by NESTS and recruited Staff will 
be the employees of NESTS. 
e. 
Qualification acquired by the candidates should be strictly in accordance with the notified/prescribed qualifications 
only and necessary original certificates should be produced at the time of interview/document verification/ selection. 
f. 
The cut-off date for determining various eligibility criteria (Educational Qualifications, age limit etc.) will be 
23.10.2025. Before applying, applicants must satisfy themselves about their eligibility as on               
23.10.2025. Even if the last date to submit application forms is extended due to administrative reasons, the cut-off 
date for determining various eligibility criteria (Educational Qualifications, age limit etc.) will be 23.10.2025 
g. 
The Reservation policy of Govt. of India applicable for direct recruitment on all India basis will be followed. Merit 
list for each post will be prepared separately on the basis of marks scored in Tier-II of ESSE-2025 in respect of all 
posts except for the post of Principal & JSA. 
h. 
The written test of Tier -II will be followed by an interview for the post of Principal. Based on the performance in 
Tier -II of ESSE 2025 and keeping in view the number of vacancies, the candidate will be called for interview/ 
Personal Interaction in the ratio of 1:3. Intimation to this effect will be uploaded on the website 
“https://nests.tribal.gov.in” in due course.  
i. 
In the case of Principal, merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks scored in Tier-II of ESSE-2025 and personal 
 
12 
 
interaction/ interview in the ratio 80% and 20% respectively. If the same score is obtained by many candidates, then 
the date of birth will be considered, with preference given to those born earlier. 
j. 
In the case of non- teaching staff, the final selection will be based on marks obtained in written in Tier -II of ESSE 
2025 only subject to the outcome of document verification. However, in respect of JSA, candidates who qualified 
the skill test (typing test) only will be considered for preparing the merit list.  
k. 
In the case of JSA, candidates will be called for skill test (Type Test through computer) based on marks obtained in 
Tier -II of ESSE 2025 written test in the ratio 1:3. Skill test (Type Test through computer) is of qualifying nature 
and it is mandatory for the shortlisted candidates to qualify the skill test. Only successful candidates of skill test 
(Type Test through computer) will be considered for document verification on the basis of performance in Tier -II 
of ESSE 2025. After the document verification, only eligible candidates will be considered for preparing the panel.  
l. 
For the consideration of selection to the notified posts, every candidate has to score a minimum of 30% in 
respect of General, OBC and EWS candidates and 25% in respect of SC, ST and PwBD candidates in Tier-
II examination. Based on the performance in Tier -II of ESSE 2025 written test and keeping in view the number 
of vacancies, the candidates will be called for document verification in the ratio of 1:3 for posts other than Principal 
and JSA. Intimation to this effect will be uploaded on the website https://nests.tribal.gov.in . After the document 
verification, only the eligible candidates will be considered for preparing the panel for notified posts. Panel 
of eligible candidates will be having the validity period of 2 years from the date of publication of the panel 
and will be operated as and when vacancies arise. 
m. The list of short-listed candidates for document verification for all the posts notified in this recruitment notification 
may be displayed on the NESTS website (or status shown in candidates’ application login). No separate 
correspondence will be entertained in this regard. 
n. 
Even if Admit Card is issued to a candidate due to lack of information in the application form or otherwise and if it 
is found at any stage (including the date of joining & thereafter) that the candidate is not eligible, then his/ her 
candidature shall be summarily rejected. 
o. 
The candidate’s response sheet and other related papers/documents of examination in respect of this recruitment 
shall be kept on record for two months only from the date of publication of result. 
p. 
The final selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit Tier -II of ESSE 2025 for all posts other than 
Principal, notified category vis-à-vis vacancies. Final selection of candidates in respect of Principal will be based 
on the performance in Tier -II of ESSE 2025  & interview/personal interaction.  The selected candidates can be 
posted in any EMRS across the country with all India transfer liability. Posting will be at the sole discretion of 
NESTS. Candidates who have been selected for posting has to learn the local language of the place of posting within 
the period of probation and qualify the language proficiency test which will be conducted by NESTS within the 
probation period. 
q. 
Selected candidates will initially be on probation for a period of two years, which can be extended at the discretion 
of the Competent Authority. During the probation period, services of probationer can be terminated at any time 
without assigning any reason thereof.  
r. 
The candidates should take a printout of the online application confirmation page and preserve it for their record 
and should not send the same to NESTS or to any other address. The confirmation page printout will also have to 
be submitted at the time of interview/document verification, as the case may be, along with the self-attested copies 
of certificates in support of Age, Qualification, Experience, Caste, Non-Creamy Layer, Physical disability & 
Economically Weaker Section (EWS), as applicable. 
s. 
The name of the candidate and his/her father/mother/husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the online application 
as it appears in the certificates/mark sheets. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.

3.4 Marking Scheme 
One mark (1) shall be awarded to every correct answer and 1/3 marks shall be deducted for every incorrect 
answer. Unanswered questions will not be given any marks. 
Important Note for Multiple Choice Questions – To answer a question, the candidates need to mark only 
one option on the OMR sheet corresponding to the correct answer. Filling up or darkening more than one 
response in any question will be treated as wrong response and 1/3 marks will be deducted as in the case 
of incorrect answer. Further, if any misprinting or ambiguity in any of the question(s) is noticed by the 
subject experts at the time of verification of challenges of answer keys after conduct of examination, a 
policy decision will be taken as per the recommendation of subject experts. 
 
20 
 
Display of Scanned Image of OMR Answer Sheet and Answer Keys 
Provision to download the scanned image of attempted OMR answer sheet by the respective candidate 
will be made on the website of NESTS for which a public notice will also be issued on the website 
https://nests.tribal.gov.in . Simultaneously, the Provisional Answer Keys of examination will also be 
displayed on website of NESTS with a public notice on the website https://nests.tribal.gov.in . The 
candidates may download the same in the stipulated time as notified in the Public Notice. The Provisional 
Answer Keys are likely to be displayed for two to three days to provide an opportunity to the candidates to 
challenge the answer(s) with a non- refundable prescribed fee of Rs.1000/- per question as processing 
charges, in case they are not satisfied with any of the answer(s). Only paid challenges made during 
stipulated time will be considered.  Challenges without payment of fee and those submitted on any other 
medium (viz. email/letter/representation) will not be considered. The subject experts will examine all the 
challenges received and then the final answer keys will be prepared by them. The decision of subject 
experts on the challenges shall be final and no further communication will be entertained. The candidates 
will not be informed individually about the status of their challenges. The result will be declared according 
to the final answer keys prepared by the subject experts. In case challenge on answer key(s) is accepted 
by the subject expert(s), the amount will be refunded to concerned candidate after declaration of result. 
No grievance with regard to answer key(s) after declaration of result will be entertained.

• The e-Admit Card will be issued through the website of NESTS based on the information filled 
by the candidate and subject to receipt of prescribed application fee.

• In no case, the duplicate Admit Card for EMRS Staff Selection Exam- 2025 would be issued at 
the Examination Centres. 
• The candidates will have to appear in the examination at the given Centre on the date and 
shift/timing as indicated in his/her e-Admit Card. 
• No candidate will be allowed to appear at the examination center, on the date and shift/time other 
than that allotted to him/her in his/her Admit card. 
• In case a candidate is unable to download his/her Admit Card from the website, he/she should 
approach the Help Line Number 011-22240112 between 09:00 am to 05:30 pm on working days 
or email his/her query on email id: emrsrecuritment25@cbseshiksha.in

them during the examination.

the candidates in their online application form. The requests for any correction in the particulars 
shown on the admit card will not be entertained. However, in case of any other discrepancy related

approach the  Help Line Number 011-22240112 between 09:00 am to 05:30 pm on working days or 
email his/her query on emrsrecuritment25@cbseshiksha.in All such queries shall be entertained

4.3 Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Reservation Policy: (As per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-
Estt (Res) dated 31st January 2019) 
Candidates who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SC/ST/OBC and whose 
family gross annual income is below Rs. 8 Lakh (Rupees Eight Lakh) shall be eligible for benefit 
of reservation for EWS. The income shall also include income from all sources i.e., salary, 
agriculture, business, profession etc. The EWS certificate (Appendix – III) must be based on 
the income for the financial year prior to the cut off date for determining the eligibility. i.e. on 
the basis of income for the financial year 2024-25.   
a. Also, candidates whose family owns or possesses any of the following assets shall be excluded from 
being identified as EWS, irrespective of family income: - 
i. 5 Acres of agriculture land and above. 
ii. Residential flat of 1000 Sq Ft and above. 
iii. Residential plot of 100 Sq yards and above in notified municipalities. 
iv. Residential plot of 200 Sq Yd and above in areas other than the notified municipalities. 
b. The property held by a family in different locations or different places / cities would be clubbed 
while applying the land or property holding test to determine EWS status. (The term Family – for this 
purpose will include the person who seeks benefit of reservation, his/her parents and siblings below the 
age of 18 years as also his/ her spouse and children below the age of 18 years). 
c. The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an income and asset 
certificate issued by a competent authority. The income and asset certificate issued by any one of the 
following authorities shall only be accepted as candidate’s claim as belonging to EWS:- 
i. District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/ Collector /Deputy Commissioner/ 
Additional Deputy Commissioner/ 1st Class Stipendiary Magistrate/Sub Divisional 
Magistrate/Taluka Magistrate/Executive Magistrate/Extra Assistant Commissioner; or 
ii. Chief Presidency Magistrate/Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Presidency Magistrate; 
or 
iii. Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar; or 
iv. Sub-Divisional Officer of the area where the candidates and/or his/her family normally 
resides. 
d. The candidate applying against the vacancies reserved for EWS must possess Income and asset 
certificate as on cut off date of online application for this advertisement. Accordingly, these candidates 
are required to produce valid Income and asset certificate during document verification stage. And 
asset certificate should be valid for the year in which this recruitment notification is published. In case 
of non- compliance of aforesaid stipulations, their claim for reserved status under EWS shall not 
be entertained and the candidature of such candidates, if fulfilling all the eligibility conditions 
for General (UR) category, shall be considered under General (UR) vacancies only.

be allowed on production of a certificate to the effect that the person concerned has physical

Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government Health Care

certificate to the effect that person concerned has limitation to write and that scribe is

CHAPTER 5. UNFAIR MEANS PRACTICES AND BREACH OF 
EXAMINATION RULES 
5.1 Definition of Unfair Means Practices 
Unfair Means practice is an activity that allows a candidate to gain an unfair advantage over other 
candidates. It includes, but is not limited to: 
a) Being in possession of any item or article which has been prohibited or can be used for unfair practices 
including any stationery item, communication device, accessories, eatable items, ornaments or any other 
material or information relevant or not relevant to the examination in the paper concerned; 
b) Using someone to write examination (impersonation) or preparing material for copying; 
c) Breaching examination rules or any direction issued by NESTS in connection with ESSE-2025 from time to 
time; 
d) Assisting other candidate to engage in malpractices, giving or receiving assistance directly or indirectly of 
any kind or attempting to do so; 
e) Contacting or communicating or trying to do so with any person, other than the Examination Staff, during 
the examination time in the Examination Centre; 
f) Threatening any of the officials connected with the conduct of the examination or threatening any of the 
candidates; 
g) Using or attempting to use any other undesirable method or means in connection with the examination; 
h) Manipulation and fabrication of online documents viz. Admit Card, Self-Declaration, etc.; 
i) Forceful entry/exit from Examination Centre/Hall; 
j) Use or attempted use of any electronic device after entering the Examination Centre; 
k) Affixing/uploading of wrong/morphed photographs/signature on the Application Form/Admit Card/ Proforma; 
l) Creating obstacles in smooth and fair conduct of examination. 
m) Any other malpractices declared as Unfair Means by the NESTS. 
 
5.2 Punishment for using Unfair means practices 
During the course of, before or after the examination if a candidate indulges in any of the above or similar 
practice, he/she shall be deemed to have used unfair practices and booked under UNFAIR MEANS (U.F.M.) 
case shall be disqualified. The candidate shall also be liable for criminal proceedings and /or any other 
action as deemed fit. 
5.3 Cancellation of Result 
The result of ESSE-2025 of the candidate(s) who indulge in Unfair means Practices will be cancelled and will 
not be declared.

तरुण कुमार दाश को ममला राष्ट्रीय मशक्षक पुरस्कार 
भारत की राष्ट्रपतत श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुममू द्वारा पीएम श्री केन्द्द्रीय तिद्यालय कोरापुट के तिक्षक श्री तरुण कुमार दाि 
को राष्ट्रीय तिक्षक पुरस्कार-2025 से अलंकृत तकया गया। इस पुरस्कार के अंतगूत उन्द्हें एक पदक, प्रितस्त पत्र 
और नकद राति प्रदान की गई। इससे पहले उन्द्हे प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी से भी तमलने का अिसर तमला। श्री दाि को 
यह पुरस्कार उनकी रचनात्मक लघु तिल्मों (पतहया कुसी, दादाजी का थैला, सड़क, मास्टर जी, बच्चों की 
जुबानी, पररितून और घर-घर ततरंगा) के माध्यम से तिक्षा की अलख जगाने और समाज को प्रेररत करने के तलए 
तदया गया। श्री दाि द्वारा तनतमूत प्रेरणादायी लघु तिल्मों की एक तििेषता यह भी है तक उनकी तिल्मों में केन्द्द्रीय 
तिद्यालयों के तिद्यातथूयों, तिक्षकों और अतभभािकों द्वारा ही अतभनय तकया गया है। श्री दाि अपनी इन लघु 
तिल्मों के माध्यम से तितभन्द्न सामातजक संदेि देने में सिल रहे हैं।

Note-Teachers appointed on contractual basis will have no claim or right for appointment on regular 
basis, nor will they be a part of the cadre of teachers of EklavyaVidyalayas. 
a. Teachers appointed on contractual basis will not be entitled for vacation pay and during 
autumn/ Winter Break payment shall be calculated on the basis of EMRS norms. 
b.  Teachers will not be entitled for pay, if remain absent on working day. In case of absence 
from duty, payment will be calculated on basis of EMRS norms. 
c. The interview is being conducted on the basis of vacant posts or posts expected to be vacant 
because of various reasons. If a candidate is selected through interview, it will not provide 
him/her right to join. He/ she can not claim till when he/ she is not called to join school 
officially. 
 
JOB DESCRIPTION OF TEACHERS (PGT, TGT): 
Contractual teachers will perform all the duties similar to a regular teacher. Their job description 
includes- 
1. Teaching of their subject as per EMRS and CBSE standards. 
2. Timely correction of class and home assignments, test-papers, projects, etc. 
3. Setting of question papers for various tests and exams, when asked by the examination 
department.  
4. Plans and maintain academic record of the students. 
5. Preparing the students for co-curricular activities, house activities, various cultural competitions, 
etc. 
6. If required, escorting the students for activities outside Vidyalaya. 
7. Completion of any other work assigned by Vidyalaya. 
8. EMRS is a residential school. It is mandatory to stay in school campus. If the quarter is not 
available, the employee self has to make his/her own arrangement to live out of school campus. 
9. The duties of HM/AHM, Escort, Escort duty, MoD etc are mandatory to be performed if assigned 
by school administration. 
10. Any other duty assigned by school administration. 
 
JOB DESCRIPTION OF FEMALE STAFF NURSE: 
1. Services of nurse will be required throughout school time and as per requirement. 
2. Nurse should be available on all days for the students except during the vacations/ breaks or 
when the school is closed on other account. 
3. Nurse shall do the medical check-up of the students Monthly. 
4. She shall be available for all emergencies in school. 
5. They will carry out awareness programme in assembly and classrooms on issues related to 
health like obesity, malnutrition, diet, communicable diseases, adolescent related problems, 
health and hygiene, etc.  
 
JOB DESCRIPTION OF COUNSELLOR: 
1. Counsellors will address the mental health of the students and provide them guidance as and 
when required. 
2. They will carry out awareness programmes to enhance life skills and values. 
3. They will address the behaviour pattern of the students and contribute to school discipline. 
4. Their nature of work involves low achieving, under achieving, and high achieving students, 
besides dealing with topics like examination fear, stress management, study skills and 
techniques, etc. 
5. They will provide career guidance and help the students in assessing their interests and 
aptitudes. 
JOB DESCRIPTION OF ART AND CRAFT Teacher- 
The instructor will perform all the duties similar to regular teachers in these subjects. Their job 
description includes- 
1. Developing the ability of creative expression/ teaching techniques, tactics and relevant skills 
activities in students/ to provide theoretical and applied instructions in computer functionality. 
2. Developing lessons plans related to their subjects. 
3. Assisting the regular teachers in developing the proficiencies related to their subject 
4. Preparing the students for various school levels, regional level and national level competitions.

रायपुर दिनांक 10.05.2021, छत्तीसगढ़ शासन स्कूल शिक्षा विभाग, मंत्रालय, महानदी भवन, नवा रायपुर अटल नगर के पत्र
क्रमांक एफ 23-08/2020/20-तीन नवा रायपुर अटल नगर, दिनांक 30.06.2021, छत्तीसगढ़ शासन स्कूल शिक्षा विभाग
मंत्रालय, महानदी भवन, अटल नगर नवा रायपुर के आदेश क्रमांक एफ 23-08/2020/20-दों/61 एवं 62 अटल नगर,
नवा रायपुर, दिनांक 24/06/2022, छत्तीसगढ़ शासन स्कूल शिक्षा विभाग मंत्रालय, महनदी भवन, अटल नगर नवा रायपुर
के आदेश क्रमांक एफ 23-08/2020/20-दों/1698,1700,1704,1702,1706,1708,1710 एवं 1712, अटल नगर, नवा
रायपुर, दिनांक 02/05/2023 द्वारा दिये गये निर्देशों के तहत् जिले में संचालित स्वामी आत्मानंद उत्कृष्ट अंग्रेजी माध्यम
विद्यालयो में निम्नानुसार संविदा प्रतिनियुक्ति पर शिक्षकों कर्मचारियों की व्यवस्था किये जाने हेतु निर्देश प्राप्त हुए, जिसके
परिपालन में कार्यालय कलेक्टर एवं पदेन अध्यक्ष स्वामी आत्मानंद उत्कृष्ट अंग्रेजी माध्यम विद्यालय संचालन समिति जिला
बीजापुर के जारी विज्ञप्ति क्रमांक 2421 / स्था. उ.अ.मा.

बीजापुर दिनांक 22.10.2025 द्वारा जिले में 14 नवीन संचालित स्वामी आत्मानंद उत्कृष्ट अंग्रेजी माध्यम विद्यालय मे सहायक
शिक्षक, शिक्षक, कम्प्यूटर शिक्षक, व्यायाम शिक्षक, ग्रंथपाल, व्याख्याता एवं सहायक शिक्षक प्रयोगशाल की संविदा प्रतिनियुक्ति
भर्ती हेतु विज्ञापन जारी कर दिनांक 28.10.2025 दावा-आपत्ति आवेदन आमंत्रित किया गया था। प्राप्त दावा-आपत्ति आवेदनो

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION: 
A. Four years integrated degree course ofRegional College of Education of NCERT or other NCTE recognized 
institution in concerned subject 
OR 
Bachelors Honours Degree in the concerned subject. Candidate should have studied requisite subjects for at least 2 
years in the 03 years degree course.: 
OR 
Bachelors Degree from a recognized university in concerned subject. The candidate should have studied the 
requisite subjects in all three years of degree course. 
Note :- 
Post wise elective subjects and Languages in the combination of subjects are as under: 
a) For TGT (Hindi): Hindi as a subject in all the three years of Degree course. 
b) For TGT (English): English as a subject in all the three years of Degree course. 
c) For TGT (Maths): 
(i) Bachelors Degree in Mathematics along with Physics and any one of the following subjects: Chemistry 
,.Electronics, ComputerScience, Statistics.  
 (ii) In case of such Universities which provide for only two subjects out of the six as mentioned above in the final 
year of graduation, the candidate should have studied Maths and Physics in the final year of examination and three 
subjects, viz, Maths, Physics and Chemistry / Electronics / Computer Science / Statistics in the first and second 
years of graduation. 
(iii) Candidates who have passed B.Sc. degree with Honours in Maths subject would be considered eligible only if 
they have studied Physics and Chemistry / Electronics / Computer Science / Statistics in any of the two years of the 
course. Candidates with B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for the post of TGT (Maths). 
d) For TGT (Science): -Botany, Zoology and Chemistry. 
(i) The candidate should have studied Botany, Zoology and Chemistry during all the three years of study in 
graduation. 
(ii) In case of such Universities which provide for only two subjects in the final year of graduation, the candidates 
should have studied any of the two subjects out of Botany, Zoology and Chemistry in the final year of examination and 
all the three subjects, viz. Botany, Zoology and Chemistry in the first and second years of graduation. 
(iii) In case of Honours Degree in any of the above mentioned three subjects, the candidate must have studied other 
two subjects in any of the two years of the course 
 
(e) For TGT (Social Studies): 
(i) The candidate should have studied any of the two subjects outof the following subjectcombination at graduation 
level: 
 
 
(a) History with Geography/ Economics/ Political Science 
OR 
(b) Geography with History/ Economics/ Political Science (in other words candidates should have studied any two 
subjects out of History, Geography, Economics and Political Science, in which one must be either History or 
Geography)  
(ii) History/Geography as above should have been studied for all three years in the Graduation. 
(iii) In case of Honours Degree in History the candidate should have studied Geography /Economics/Political Science 
in any of the two years of the course. Similarly in case of Honours degree in Geography,the candidate should have 
studied History/ Economics/ Political Science inany of the two years of the course. Candidates with B.A. (Honours) in 
Economics or Political Science are not eligible for the post of TGT (S.Science)  
(f) For TGT (Sanskrit):Sanskrit as a subject / elective subject in all the three years of Degree Course. 
And for all TGTs 
(B) Passed the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE in accordance with the guidelines framed 
by the NCTE, for the purpose.  
(C) B.Ed. Degree* 
(D) Competence to teach through English and Hindi. 
*Note: 
B.Ed. degree not applicable for 04 years integrated degree course as mentioned in sub clause (C) above.
